How this was tested

Historical tests of FTM MACHINE in MetaTrader 5, with all profits reinvested and leverage 1:100. Every trade has a stop loss and is sized from the account balance according to the risk profile.

  • Gold (XAUUSD): 1 January 2020 to 8 October 2026, starting balances from $500 to $1M.
  • Bitcoin (BTCUSD): 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026, starting balances from $1k to $100k.
  • USD/JPY (USDJPY): 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026, starting balances from $1k to $100k.
  • US Tech 100 (NDX100): 1 November 2022 to 16 October 2026, starting balances $10k and $100k.
  • Boom 1000 (BOOM1000, synthetic index): 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026, starting balances $10k and $100k.
  • HK50 (Hang Seng stock index): 1 August 2022 to 16 October 2026, starting balances $10k and $100k.
  • All in one: every trade from the gold, Bitcoin, USD/JPY, US Tech 100 and HK50 tests replayed in time order on one shared balance with shared margin, 1 January 2020 to 16 October 2026. US Tech 100 and HK50 join in 2022, when their price history starts. Starting balances $500 to $1M; at $1k and $500 only gold, Bitcoin and USD/JPY are traded.
